description: The large terminal of the nobodys-cave-island remake: a solid rock massif whose terraced switchback path (grass-to-stone, walked natively via stair treads) climbs the south face to a cave-mouth ledge with a basalt boulder gate region beside it, opening into ONE tall-wide cavern hall (interior 30x14x24, not rooms-and-corridors) — a cheese store by the entry, a central fire pit, a rock-shelf ramp (no ladders) up to an empty upper sheep pen, four dark shadow alcoves for stealth, dripstone and moss dressing, and two ceiling light shafts open to the sky. Polyphemus's cave.

style_fit.rationale: The purpose-built mountain terminal for the nobodys-cave-island remake (design brief §1, §5). Delivers every contracted beat in one contiguous piece: switchback approach up the face, boulder-sealable mouth, and a single tall-wide firelit cavern with cheese store, fire pit, no-ladder ramp to the upper pen, four stealth alcoves, and two sky-lit shafts. A 3D nav flood reaches every anchor from the base socket with <=1-block steps. Declared dark honestly (firelit pit, dark alcoves by design); rock fixture sites + sky shafts let the compiler relight minimally (spec-0010). Procedural rock rather than hand-crafted alpine — an AABB massif whose silhouette is broken by an enclosure-safe crown/face erosion pass.

license.note: Original Delvewright asset generated deterministically by prefabs/island-terrain-generator (island-terrain-gen), ADR-0006 — regenerating yields byte-identical NBT. No third-party material ingested. Palette audit clean (DW0730); no command/structure blocks.
